name: Rizuhble's Iron Granny Baba
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Feed The Birds unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Radiant Regeneration, vitality 4.8k at Reactive Barrier. Ultimate (Feed The Birds) is available from Radiant Regeneration.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Threadsap (1 to 2).

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Reactive Barrier completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Reactive Barrier completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-24,800 (levels 16-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Granny Long Legs T3, Baba's Brew T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Baba's Brew, combat barrier) grows from 133 to 204.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 10,400 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Granny Long Legs: its duration-scaled parts (duration 10s, heavy melee slow duration 4s) get +22%.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Threadsap (2 to 3). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 15,200 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-43,200 (levels 28-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Threadsap T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Baba's Brew, combat barrier) grows from 204 to 264.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Feed The Birds channel time (6.5s), Feed The Birds hex duration (2.8s), Baba's Brew silence duration (36.3s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 28.8 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if stuns keep cancelling your ult.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Feed The Birds's barrage max damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming, like Bebop's hook or Apollo's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hitting you.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Torment Pulse, Brew and Threadsap bullets all hit often, so the lifesteal heals a lot. Sell Fortitude for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
